title: Affine stalk localization and canonical cohomology base change
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an affine open and z a point of U. Put A=Gamma(X,U), p=hU.isoSpec(z), and S=O_X,z. For any K-flat complex M of A-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex], let L be its affine associated-sheaf complex [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model] on the over-site of U and C its stalk transported to S [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor]. Then C is K-flat. Moreover, the canonical cohomology base-change map [def-pc-module-cohomology-base-change] kappa(p) tensor_A H^0(M) -> H^0(kappa(p) tensor_A M) is epi if and only if the corresponding map kappa(S) tensor_S H^0(C) -> H^0(kappa(S) tensor_S C) is epi. No derived model, finiteness, boundedness, perfection or surjectivity hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: The associated-sheaf stalk is naturally S tensor_A M: the tilde stalk is localization at p, and the chart and open-immersion stalk maps transport its local ring to S. The germ and pure-tensor formulas commute with module maps, hence with the differentials of M.

proof.text: For an acyclic S-complex N, its restriction to A is acyclic. Tensor associativity identifies N tensor_S C with N tensor_A M; K-flatness of M proves the former acyclic. The module complex C is therefore K-flat.

proof.text: The residue maps of the open immersion and affine chart, and Spec.residueFieldIso, identify kappa(S) and kappa(p) compatibly with section evaluation. Flat localization commutes with homology. Under these source and target isomorphisms, the canonical base-change arrows coincide: their defining adjunction units both send a cycle to 1 tensor that cycle. Conjugating by the isomorphisms preserves and reflects epimorphy.

theorem affine_model_stalk_baseChange (X : Scheme.{u})
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (z : U.toScheme)
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ℤ)
    (hM : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso
      (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))) (.up ℤ)).kFlat M) :
    let L := ((Scheme.affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj M
    let C := ((openModuleStalkFunctor X U z).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L
    (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso
      (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk (U.ι z))) (.up ℤ)).kFlat C ∧
    (Epi (ModuleCat.cohomologyBaseChange
      (B := (hU.isoSpec.hom z).asIdeal.ResidueField) M 0) ↔
      Epi (ModuleCat.cohomologyBaseChange
        (B := IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (U.ι z))) C 0))
